svg.title: Dr. Jetski Studios — compact logo
svg.desc: Copper Dr. and warm-gold Jetski arcade lettering leans forward through muted blue water with ivory foam tracing the waves and a small crest on the right. Foreground J and e overlaps blend with the lower shading, and Studios appears in an enlarged cream italic signature beneath Jetski for small displays.
